# Table 1. Pathway levers and the theoretical-limit assumptions (generated by tools/pathways_methods.py from outputs/data/pathways/levers.json and outputs/data/pathways/theoretical_limit.json; do not edit by hand)

The Reference projection; each lever follows a normalised logistic adoption path from 2026 (observed, unchanged) to full strength in 2035 (full roll-out by 2035 following RECC (Pauliuk et al. 2024, J. Ind. Ecol. 28, 1699: circular-economy strategies fully implemented by 2035); sensitivities: full roll-out by 2030 and by 2045). One rule for every adoption window 2026 → E (W = E − 2026): midpoint 2026 + W/2, speed k = ln(81) / (2W/3), 10-90% of adoption within the middle two-thirds of the window; w(2026) = 0, w(E) = 1, w = 1 after E (by 2035: midpoint 2030.5, k = 0.7324; by 2030: 2028, 1.6479; by 2045: 2035.5, 0.3469). Levers L1-L9 in four pathway families (P1 Space per person, P2 Existing stock, P3 Construction, P4 Land; P5 combines them); business-as-usual decarbonisation applies in every run; only population growth is untargeted. The typology shares stay at the Reference held mix in every run. Tags: DATA (measured), LITERATURE (cited), DECISION (author).

**Removed lever.** The denser typology mix (lever of pathways_v2, removed in pathways_v3.1) was not carried forward: within the embodied-carbon scope a denser mix raises A1-A3 per m2 (attached typologies carry more per m2), while its benefits (infrastructure, operational energy, land) are outside the scope. Values from git tag pathways_v2 (Reference): attached share 39.40% -> 41.39% / 55.40% (Moderate / Ambitious); carbon -0.39% / -2.94% vs the Reference; floor area 89.57 -> 88.85 / 84.16 Mm²; carbon per m² 240.9 -> 241.9 / 248.8 kg CO₂e; lever Shapley share of Reference − P5 1.7% / 5.8%.

## Theoretical limit TL

> TL is a hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway: every lever at its limit, adopted by 2030, combining best observed attributes of different buildings and places; not a proposal or a feasible pathway (potentials hierarchy: theoretical > technical > realisable).

TL = P5 Combined (Moderate) with TL1-TL10, every lever and TL item on the standard adoption rule with full roll-out by 2030 (the window of the pathways' 2030 sensitivity); 2026 observed and untouched; the dwellings released by zero vacancy, by the household-size change and by the absorbed 2026 overbuild are re-occupied at a constant share of each year's need. Each TL item is the limit of one lever (TL10 has no lever counterpart) and is asserted at least as strong as that lever's Ambitious setting (pathways.compute_tl stops otherwise). The adopted decarbonisation applies in TL as in every run (A1-A3 item paths of Horup et al. 2025; A4-A5 e^(-0.01 (t - 2025)) until TL7 sets A4-A5 to zero).
